# netbox_owners (Data Source)

Lists owner objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_owners" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-owner" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: group_id, group_id__n, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `owners` (Attributes List) The matching owners. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `owner_group_id` (Number) Id of the owner group the owner belongs to.
- `url` (String)
- `user_group_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the user groups that make up the owner.
- `user_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the users that make up the owner.
